name: Caprese Chicken Skillet

fit.note: 419 cal / 21g carbs clears 400-650 cal and <=35g carb; seared chicken breast, no rice/pasta/potato; weigh-and-divide scales to 14.

dupe_evidence: No catalog collision: nearest chicken-skillet in the accepted list, creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet, is a cream + sun-dried-tomato + spinach sauce, whereas this is a no-cream balsamic-glaze + fresh-tomato + fresh-mozzarella + basil caprese plate (different sauce family); no caprese/balsamic-tomato-mozzarella chicken exists in the digest.
cross_protein_flags: Caprese format (balsamic glaze + tomato + fresh mozzarella + basil over a seared protein) is the same dish idea as a caprese/balsamic pork chop, caprese turkey cutlet, or balsamic-caprese steak - decider should scan other-protein pools for a caprese or balsamic-tomato-mozzarella twin.
